name: Ivory Ceramic Vase
description: A rounded ivory ceramic vase with a narrow neck and a softly textured matte finish. A quiet accent for a shelf, table or bedside.
descriptionZh: 圆润瓶身搭配细窄瓶口，米白哑光表面带有细腻纹理，适合点缀书架、餐桌或床头。

name: Seagrass Storage Basket
description: A natural woven seagrass basket with two loop handles. Keep throws, magazines and everyday essentials neatly together.
descriptionZh: 天然海草编织篮配有双侧提手，可收纳盖毯、杂志与日常小物，让空间保持整洁。

name: Sage Linen Cushion
description: A square sage-green linen cushion with a subtle woven texture and a piped edge. A soft finishing touch for a sofa or reading chair.
descriptionZh: 鼠尾草绿色方形亚麻靠垫，细腻织纹搭配包边设计，为沙发或阅读椅增添柔和色彩。

name: Oak Serving Tray
description: An oval light-oak tray with a shallow raised rim. Carry a morning coffee or organise a few favourites on your table.
descriptionZh: 浅色橡木椭圆托盘，微微隆起的边缘方便放置物品，适合端放晨间咖啡或整理桌面。

name: Sandstone Ceramic Mug
description: A sand-beige ceramic mug with a rounded handle and a softly speckled glaze. A simple companion for coffee or tea.
descriptionZh: 沙米色陶瓷马克杯，圆润把手搭配细斑釉面，适合日常咖啡与茶饮。

name: Oatmeal Cotton Throw
description: An oatmeal woven cotton throw with short fringed edges. Fold it over a sofa or keep it nearby for quiet evenings.
descriptionZh: 燕麦色纯棉编织盖毯，搭配短流苏边缘，可铺在沙发上，也可在休闲时披盖。

name: Linen Bedside Lamp
description: A compact bedside lamp with a rounded ivory ceramic base and a natural linen shade. A gentle accent for a reading corner.
descriptionZh: 小巧床头灯，圆润米白陶瓷底座搭配天然亚麻灯罩，为阅读角落增添柔和氛围。

name: Oak Wall Clock
description: A round wall clock with a light oak frame, cream dial and simple dark hour markers. A quiet finishing touch for everyday spaces.
descriptionZh: 圆形挂钟采用浅色橡木边框、奶油色表盘与简洁深色刻度，为日常空间增添自然质感。
